name: Discount Addition Instead of Subtraction
description: calculate_discount adds the discount amount to price instead of subtracting it.
valid_search_block:
# Defect: adds discount to price instead of subtracting it
    return price + (price * discount_percent / 100.0)
valid_replace_block:
# Fixed: subtract discount from price
    return price - (price * discount_percent / 100.0)
